_readme: Production manifest for the modular wardrobe. One mesh per (wardrobe, slot) serves ALL races:
every body shares one AccuRig UE5 skeleton, so a garment fitted once in MetaTailor applies broadly.
PIPELINE: Tripo Studio (generate) -> download GLB -> scripts/optimize-prop-glb.cjs -> MetaTailor
(auto-fit + auto-skin-weight against an imported AccuRig avatar) -> FBX -> GLB -> app.
EVERY garment except a helmet needs real skin weights. A rigid bone-parented prop is only correct
when it covers ONE rigid bone (a skull). Gloves span 15+ finger bones, pauldrons span clavicle to
upperarm, boots flex at the ball. So MetaTailor is on the path for all of these.
TRIPO SETTINGS (set once, saved between runs): HD Model, v3.1 Best Quality, Ultra Mesh Quality ON,
Texture Quality 2K, PBR ON, Topology Triangle, Polycount 30000. That is 45 credits/model; the
defaults (4K / 2,000,000 polycount) cost 55 and produce ~6MB files. Export as GLB at 1k texture.
status: NOT_STARTED | GENERATING | REJECTED | TRIPO_ACCEPTED | FITTING | FIT_PASSED | BLOCKED
styleSuffix: Semi-realistic grounded fantasy-RPG style, moderate animation-friendly detail, clean readable shapes, believable thickness, hollow inside, joints unobstructed, suitable for automatic fitting and skin weighting. It floats alone in empty space with nothing underneath or supporting it.
negativeSuffix: No body, mannequin, skin, head, face, hair, weapon, shield, stand, floor, background, or text.

wardrobes.heavy: Fortress knight plate. Blackened steel with brass rivets, worn leather straps, layered overlapping lames, raised outer ridges.
wardrobes.medium: Warden brigandine. Riveted steel plates over oxblood leather, canvas backing, buckled straps, functional and worn.
wardrobes.light: Scout leathers. Supple dark brown hide, minimal stitched panels, cloth wrap accents, no metal plating.
wardrobes.sorcerer: Arcane vestments. Deep indigo and slate wool, silver embroidered geometric trim, layered cloth, no armor plating.
wardrobes.cultural: Ceremonial regalia. Bone-white lacquered scale, verdigris bronze fittings, woven sash detailing, tribal geometric motifs.

pieces.note: Generated 2026-08-03, BEFORE the anti-fusion line existed in armor-prompt.cjs. Rendered on its own (scratch-armor/app-shot.mjs --solo) it is NOT a torso at all: two shoulder assemblies plus a small sternum bib, with the chest and back left as open arches. Reclassified SHOULDERS, which is what it is. Fits correctly as a yoke via: --slot torso --height 0.72 --core 0.6 --top clavicle_l --topdy 6 --inflate 0.4. A real heavy TORSO still needs generating.

Sourced from scratch-armor/raw/leather+torso+armor+3d+model.glb — generated 2026-08-03 and never used. A proper CLOSED cuirass. Zero new credits. Fitted with: --slot torso --yaw 90 --core 1 --no-arms --ease 1.20 --inflate 0.5. The yaw matters: Tripo shipped it turned 90deg (0.40 wide x 0.58 deep, and a torso is wider than deep), so the auto-fit was sizing width against depth until corrected.
